Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
Hey... can I ask you something？
What？
Am I really the right one for you？
Huh？ Why are you asking that so suddenly...
Well, I'm older... so I wondered if you had any regrets.
There's no way I'd regret it. Age doesn't matter when it comes to falling for someone.
...I see. I'm glad.
I mean it, believe me.
Okay... sorry. I just got a little worried.
Anegasaki
...Hey, I want you to answer honestly.
What？
What type of girl do you really like？
Type...
Well, I'm a bit of a busybody, right？
Are you？ It doesn't bother me, though...
And I'm older... you know, don't guys like younger girls better than older ones？
I think that depends on the person.
You're not forcing yourself to date me, are you？
Absolutely not. Trust me, okay？
Okay, I believe you. Sorry for asking something weird.
Anegasaki
Can I ask you something？
Yeah, what？ What's up？
What do you think it means to become lovers？
Doesn't it mean falling for each other？
Geez, think about it properly.
Um... caring about the other person and feeling like you want to be with them, I guess？
But once you actually become lovers, you start wavering, right？ Wondering if you're really good enough...
Is that so？
...Hehe, maybe that's still a bit hard for you？
Treating me like a kid again...
Anegasaki
What do you think makes someone fall for someone？
What makes them fall？
Everyone starts out as strangers, right？ But when you meet and fall in love, that person becomes irreplaceable...
Right. When you think about it, it's strange.
Yeah... until recently they were a stranger, and now it can't be anyone but them...
It can't be anyone else？
Thinking about that person day and night... it hurts... it should make you happy, but you feel lonely...
Is ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ like that too？
Hehe. Who knows. But I'd like to stay a dreamy girl a while longer, I guess.
Anegasaki
Hey, come to think of it, it's coming up soon, right？
Um, what was it？
Huh, did I get it wrong？ I meant your birthday...
Oh, right. You'd be surprised how easy it is to forget.
Geez, it's your own birthday... ah, more importantly, is there anything you want？
Hmm, there's nothing in particular that I want.
Nope～. Don't hold back at times like this. Celebrating her boyfriend's birthday makes a girlfriend happy too. Okay？
Got it...
Hehe. Feel free to look forward to it.
(I'm happy, but how fired up she is makes me a little nervous...)
Anegasaki
Come to think of it, about your birthday.
Yeah, what？
What was it like before？ Can you tell me？
Nothing special, just people around me saying happy birthday, that's about it.
That's all？ No celebration or anything？
When I was little, sure... but isn't that how it is for everyone？
That's fine for friends, but as your girlfriend, it's a bit, you know.
Is that how it is...
That's how it is.
I see. Hmm, that's tough.
...Hehe, you're funny. But somehow, it's very you, so it's nice.
Anegasaki
I've been thinking about all sorts of things...
What are you talking about？
About your birthday. It's coming up, right？
Ah, right.
I want to give you a present. What do you want？
Even if you ask so suddenly... hmm, I can't think of anything. Anything's fine.
Geez, boring. There must be something. Don't hold back, tell me.
Then... how about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
...？ As long as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is with me, that's enough？
You're... really something.
(What...？)
Anegasaki
Come to think of it, about the birthday present...
Right. My birthday...
For starters, I'll have myself ready. I'll definitely come see you.
Yeah, thanks.
Then there's the present, right？ What should I do...
You don't have to think so seriously... though I'm happy.
Hmm, about that.
Of course I want you to be happy, but it's for my sake too.
What do you mean？
Agonizing over things for my boyfriend is really fun. So let me enjoy it a little longer？
Anegasaki
Sigh... every year around this time, I get depressed.
Why？
It's almost my birthday, right？
Right. We have to celebrate big.
It's fine. I'm not really in the mood for a celebration.
...Why？
Because I'll be one year closer to being an old lady...
Ah, is that all.
"Is that all"...
I mean, say, a 90-year-old and a 91-year-old granny, there's no difference, right？
That's not helping, you know...
Anegasaki
Even if I dread it, my birthday comes anyway.
Is there anything ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ wants？
Ah, are you giving me a present？
What would you like？ I'll splurge.
That's something you have to choose. It'd be boring if I knew in advance, right？
But I'm not confident choosing myself... I have no idea what girls want.
If it's something the person you love picked out, anything makes a girl happy, you know...
Is that so？ Then...
Hey, something normal is fine, okay？ Just something normal.
Anegasaki
It's nice to have friends and family celebrate your birthday, but spending it with someone special is best, right？
Yeah, that's right.
I thought a day like that would never come for me.
No way. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is beautiful, so you must be popular, right？
I'm not popular. I'm a busybody, so I just end up looking after people. That's not love.
I wonder. You say looking after, but I don't think you can truly care for someone unless you like them.
Did I say something weird？
...I see... you'd say that about me... hehe.
What's wrong？
No, nothing. I just felt a little happy.
Anegasaki
It's almost here, my birthday.
Yeah, it's almost here.
As for me, if you just say happy birthday, that's enough.
At times like this, I want to show you a boyfriend-ish side, though...
You've already done plenty of that. ...I was really happy.
Did I do something？ I don't remember...？
It's fine if you don't remember. I'll never forget it. That's enough.
Anegasaki
Hey, it's almost been a year...
What？
Geez... you don't know？
Um... what was it？
It's almost been a year since you and I started dating, right？
A year already？ That was fast...
You really forgot... I also feel like it went by in a flash, but...
I see... it's already been a year since I started dating ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
A lot happened, huh.
But doesn't it feel a little strange？ Like we've been together even longer than that...
...Yeah. You're right. Hehe, you really are.
Anegasaki
Hey, do you remember a year ago？
...Yeah.
I confessed to you... I was so nervous back then. I'm older, so I thought you'd turn me down.
Geez, that doesn't matter...
That's when it all started for us, right？
Yeah. That's right.
Now we're this close... it's kind of surprising.
...Let's stay together from now on too, okay？
Yeah... I hope we make it to our second anniversary too. I'm getting older and older, so you might go off me.
No way！ I'm fine even if you become an old lady, even a granny.
Geez... I'm not worried about it to that extent. ...But you mean it sincerely, don't you. I'm happy.
Anegasaki
Hey, do you think I've changed this past year？
What's this all of a sudden？
Well, they say people change when they date someone they love. So I wondered if I'd changed too.
Hmm, I wonder. I feel like something's changed, but...
Ah, you can't tell. That's mean～.
How do I put it... what matters isn't whether you changed or not... ah, sorry, I can't say it well.
...You haven't changed, have you.
You think？
Yeah... the same as always... hehe.
I like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ more and more, but I guess that doesn't count as changing？
S-saying something like that with a straight face... aah, geez, you really haven't changed.
Anegasaki
Remember what we talked about the other day？
Um... about whether we'd changed？
Yeah. I've been thinking since then, and I think maybe you've changed too after all.
Really？ Yes！
...What's with that reaction？
Well, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ said it, right？ That you change when you fall for someone. But then you said I hadn't changed.
A year ago, I wasn't in your heart, right？ But now I think it's different.
Right. Yeah, it's totally different. Because now...
Don't say the rest！ I don't want my happiness to slip away by saying it out loud...
You're a poet, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Geez...
Anegasaki
Can I ask you something？
What？ Why so formal？
Um... don't lie, answer honestly, okay？
Yeah... Okay.
Am I really the right one for you？
Huh!? Wh-what... of course you are.
Don't you actually like cute younger girls？
No way. I only have eyes for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. You know that...
Really？ If you're lying, I'll make you swallow a thousand needles.
Of course I'm not！
(...Somehow, I feel like she'd really make me...)
Anegasaki
Sometimes I think...
What？
If we were in the same class, it'd be even more fun.
Hmm... I wonder？ I can't really picture it.
Is that because I'm older？ You can't picture me as your classmate？
It's not that, but... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ being older just feels right...
Could it be any older girl would have been fine...？ Are you into older girls？
Of course it's not just anyone.
...Sorry.
Was I being mean？ Sorry, I didn't mean to put you on the spot. ...Forgive me, okay？
Anegasaki
Hey, when do you think the feeling of liking someone begins？
That's hard... what does ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ think？
Hmm, in my case... it starts with wanting to know about the other person, I guess？
You mean getting interested？
Yeah, something like that.
...What if you stop wanting to know？
Hehe. Are you worried about yourself？
Hm... well, I guess？
Then it's fine. The more I know, the more I want to know.
For boys, girls are an eternal mystery, right？ But for girls, boys are a mystery too.
I see... I'm a little relieved, I guess.
Anegasaki
It makes you happy to find out the person you like likes you back, right？
Yeah, of course.
But is it just happiness？ Don't you end up liking them even more？
Maybe.
That feeling reaches them, and then it comes back to you... like that...
I get it, I get it.
Hehe. I'm glad I fell for you...
Because I fell for you, I keep getting happier and happier.
I'd be happy if you felt that way too？
Yeah, me too...
(Come to think of it, did I tell ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ That my birthday's coming up soon...)
Um, so. Actually, my bir...
Anegasaki
Ah, right. Did you see that movie on late last night？ It's a really old romance.
Huh？ No. I went to bed early last night...
I see... I didn't see it either. If you had, I wanted to hear what you thought.
I see. Anyway, it's almost my...
Ah！ Hey, hey, come to think of it...
Yeah...
(I can't find a good opening. Maybe next time...)
(...Okay. Today I'll finally tell ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ about my birthday.)
Anegasaki
Ah, right. What do you think about birthday parties？
Wh-what do I think!?
I'd get it in elementary school... but there's a girl in my class who still has them.
Huh... is that so.
Don't you think it's a bit embarrassing？ A birthday party when you're already in high school.
But if they're important friends, don't you want to celebrate...？
I'd find it embarrassing, though.
I-I see... sigh.
...What's wrong？ Hehe.
(Come to think of it, I still haven't told her... about my birthday...)
Anegasaki
Hehe... what's wrong？ Isn't there something you want to tell me？
Yeah... there is.
What is it？
(But she said before that birthday parties were embarrassing...)
Could it be something you can't tell me？
Not at all. It's nothing important, really.
Hmm. Not important at all？
Yeah, not at all！ Hahaha...
I see. Then I won't worry about it either. Hehe.
(My birthday's almost here... but at this point, I can't bring it up...)
Anegasaki
What's wrong？ You seem really down.
Ah, no. It's nothing important...
Even though it's about your birthday？
Yeah, my birthday... Eh!?
Geez... that's way too surprised.
Sorry... ah！ Could it be you knew all along？
Hehe. Believe it or not, big sis is somebody's girlfriend, you know.
Could it be... you're planning to celebrate...？
Well, who knows？ ...Hehe.
(She got me...)
(Come to think of it, it's almost ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s birthday...)
Anegasaki
Oh right. Are foreign soaps popular in your class？
Soap？
Among the girls, of course. I don't think any boys are particular about soap.
Hmm, I don't really know about the girls, but I don't think I've heard of it...？
It's a hot topic in my class. Apparently there's a soap that makes your skin smooth.
Huh, there's stuff like that.
I'm already an old lady. If I'm not careful with my skin, it gets rough right away.
Old lady... come on.
Hehe, I just mean I'm that careful.
(She's worried about her age... that makes it hard to bring up her birthday.)
(Right. I still haven't brought up ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s birthday.)
Anegasaki
Hm？ What's wrong？
Well...
Hmm？
Um...
Hmm？ Why are your eyes darting around～？
That's...
Hehe. So it's something you can't tell me. Hmm. I see.
That's not it...
Kidding, kidding. Hehe. You didn't say anything weird, so why would I get mad？
(...Maybe next time.)
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s birthday is almost here...)
Anegasaki
Hm？ What's up, you look all fired up.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！ Well...
Ah... don't tell me you've started to dislike me？ Or you got bored of me？
N-no way!?
Then, did you fall for someone else？ A classmate？ Or a younger girl？
No, that's not it...
...If that really happens, tell me right away. It's much better than being two-timed.
I wouldn't do that...
Hehe.
Anegasaki
Hey... lately, when you talk to me, there's something on your mind, isn't there？
That's not...
My birthday... right？
It's not that I'm worried about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s birthday...
Hehe. You think I'm worried about turning into an even older lady.
I see... so from your point of view, I'm so much of an old lady that you have to tiptoe around it...
No, that's not it... I just, um...
Yeah, I know. Sorry, you were so cute when you were troubled that I couldn't help teasing you.
Don't tell me, this whole time？
Hehe. I'm looking forward to my birthday, okay？
Anegasaki
Ah, come to think of it, it's almost been a year...
What's that？
Ah, you really don't remember.
Um...
Hehe. If you answer the next question correctly, I'll forgive you.
What question？
What month and day did I confess to you？
S-sorry... I can't remember the exact date...
Did you know girls are particular about anniversaries？
...I'll reflect on that. Um, probably about a year ago... ah.
Looks like you finally got it. Right, it's almost our first anniversary. Don't forget it next time, okay？
(I see, it's been a year already...)
It's already been a year... it went by in a flash...
Anegasaki
Right. Faster than I thought... I want to keep going for five years, ten years.
What's it called after fifty years？ A golden anniversary？
That's if we're married... if we date that long, I'll be a granny, you know？
By then I'll be a grandpa too.
...Hehe. I bet you'll be a cute grandpa. Don't worry. I'll take good care of you.
Why am I the one getting taken care of？ Couldn't it be the other way around？
Who knows. But I might be strict. If you can't take care of me properly, I might get mad.
Anegasaki
Walking side by side like this is really strange, isn't it？
Is it？ We're dating, so I think it's natural.
But a year ago we were total strangers, right？ If we hadn't met at work, we might not even have known we went to the same school.
I see... that's true.
Hey, do you ever think you actually wanted to date a younger girl？
No way. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is the best for me.
Just hypothetically, if I'd worked somewhere else, would I have met an older guy？
Huh... what？
Then the person walking with me now wouldn't be you... it's a big thing, fate, isn't it.
H-hey, wait...！
Hehe, kidding. So cute...
Anegasaki
A year has passed since then, and I'm with you.
Yeah, that's right.
You sometimes look at other girls, but...
Never！ Don't make stuff up.
Hehe. Kidding, kidding.
Geez...
But even this kind of back-and-forth makes me happy. I'm glad I started dating you. Next year, and the year after, let's be together, okay？
Yeah, I promise.
Hey, I just thought of something. Want to switch roles for the next year？ I'll be the spoiled one, calling you big brother.
If anything, I'd like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ to stay my big sis...
I see. So you know you're the spoiled one. Hehe... what should I do～？
Anegasaki
This is sudden, but I have a question.
What？
I've been thinking lately... am I really the right one for you？
...What's this all of a sudden？
Well... wouldn't a girlfriend your own age or younger be more fun？
That's not true. Age doesn't matter when it's someone you want by your side.
If you say so... but I can't help worrying.
You're overthinking it.
But I'm the one who confessed...
The order doesn't matter. I love ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Ah, hey, saying that here！ Geez, that's embarrassing...
Anegasaki
Hey... what did you think when I confessed to you？
What did I think？ I was happy, of course？
Really？ I'm like this, right？ Kind of... big-sisterly...
Like a self-appointed wife or something... some people hate that kind of thing, right？
I wonder？ But I love you because ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
...You're not just saying that to cheer me up？
I'm not. I promise.
...Can I be confident, then？
Of course you can.
I see... hehe, I think I feel a little better.
Anegasaki
Falling for someone isn't about logic, is it...
What's this all of a sudden？
Like... a tingly ache deep in your heart... or getting restless whenever the phone rings...
Deep in your heart？ The phone？
Like I'm not myself... my heart always pounding, feeling like I'm going to go crazy！ That kind of thing.
Sorry. I don't understand what you mean...
I'm just giving examples, but don't you feel that way？
Tingly, restless, pounding？ ...Like going to the dentist？
Not that！ Geez, what kind of imagination do you have？
Anegasaki
About what we talked about the other day... do you remember？
The dentist thing？
Seems you remember, but that's a little off from what I wanted to talk about.
Was it...
Hey, let me ask you something. Do you love me？
Yes, I love you.
Okay... right. I knew you'd say that.
Of course I would.
You say that as naturally as breathing. That's what loving someone is, isn't it. Thank you...
Anegasaki
Oh right. Your birthday's coming up soon, right？
Mine？ Yeah, though it's not that soon yet？
Geez... it's your birthday, so if you don't get excited, I'll feel lonely.
Okay, thanks.
Hehe. No need to be shy. Look, right now I'll grant any wish you want？
W-wish!?
I've saved up my part-time pay, so something a little pricey is okay too？
Th-that's okay. If I got something too expensive, I'd feel bad.
Hmm... right. If it's too expensive, it's off-putting instead.
Yeah, I'm happy about the thought, though.
Anegasaki
Oh right. About what we talked about the other day...
Is it about my birthday？
Right, is there anything you want？
Something I want... anything's fine.
That's boring. ...Then, is there anything you want me to do？
Something I want you to do？ Clean my room... I guess.
Geez... I seriously want to celebrate, you know？
Sorry... I'll think about it a bit.
Anegasaki
Oh, right. About your birthday.
Sorry, I've been thinking, but there's nothing in particular...
Do you want me to clean？
Huh？
I mean, clean your room.
That was more of a joke, or just something that popped into my head...
When you think about it, isn't it a girlfriend's privilege？ Cleaning her boyfriend's room.
Maybe, but it's fine, really. I'd be way too embarrassed...
Hmm, if you don't want me to, it can't be helped... I'm curious, though...
Anegasaki
I thought about it, and cleaning your room would be going too far, wouldn't it...
About my birthday？
Yeah, I don't want to be too much like a pushy wife...
I don't think that, but it's still embarrassing...
Is it something to be that shy about？
Anyway, I'll just take the thought on that one.
Hehe. Then I'll have to prepare a present besides the thought.
You'll give me one？
Of course. Will you look forward to it from now？
Come to think of it, it's almost ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s birthday, right？
Anegasaki
Huh？ What？
It's almost ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s birthday, isn't it？
What are you talking about？
？ I mean, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s birthday...
Um... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Sigh, I'm going to be one year older again...
(She doesn't need to worry about it that much...)
(Come to think of it, it seems ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ wants to avoid talking about her birthday...)
Anegasaki
Hm？ What's wrong？
I don't mean anything bad by it... but I'm curious, so can I ask？
Nope.
Um... do you hate talking about your birthday that much？
I do. I really, really do.
Is it... because I'm younger？
It's not about you... you know, women care about that kind of thing.
I don't mind, though...
Yeah, I know... but big sis is at a delicate age. So... okay？
...Um, so.
Anegasaki
If it's about my birthday again, I'll cry, you know？
...Not get mad, but cry？
Yeah. I'll cry.
But... I don't really know how to say it, but I'd like to celebrate if I can.
...Yeah, it's not that I don't understand that.
You get it？
...Then, how about I just accept the thought？
Just the thought？
Yeah. Even just the thought makes big sis really happy. Hehe, really, you know？
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. For your birthday, at least a present...
Anegasaki
Still on that？ Like I said, the thought alone is plenty...
But I thought about it. What if it were the other way around？
...The other way around？
If it were me, I'd be happy with anything, as long as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ celebrated with me.
Hehe. You care that much about it.
So... what do you say？
Still no good？
Okay. If you put it like that, I can't say no. But I'll get my hopes up, you know？ Are you ready？
Anegasaki
This year went by in a flash...
What's this all of a sudden？
It's strange that it's lasted a whole year.
What are you talking about？
You really forgot. Think hard. The ones who've hit a year are u-s.
...Ah！ Was it a year ago already!?
Hehe. It was around this time a year ago that we started dating. I was so nervous back then.
I was nervous too. I never thought ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ would confess to me...
...Do you think we'd have been better off not dating？
I don't think that at all, which is why we can be like this, I think... right？
Hehe. That answer passes.
Anegasaki
But it's strange, isn't it...
Did something happen？
Not that. I mean you and me being together like this.
We're dating, so isn't it natural？
That's not what I mean... falling for you, confessing, dating...
True, we were strangers at first.
The more we meet, the more irreplaceable you become... so this kind of thing really happens.
It's the same for me.
Really？ You won't get tired of me？ I'm older...
There's no way.
...I see. Yeah. Every day feels fresh to me too. I bet I'm really happy right now.
Anegasaki
Hey, shouldn't we do something for our first anniversary？
Isn't it fine not to do anything special？
Huh？ Could it be you're not interested？
It's not that. It's going to last five years, ten years, after all.
I'm happy you think that way, but thinking about the future, I really think we should celebrate.
The future？
Praying that you don't get in an accident, or get caught up in a scam, things like that.
Do I look that accident-prone？
I wonder... huh？ Saying it out loud, I'm starting to feel uneasy...
(Somehow this is drifting away from the anniversary...)
Anegasaki
I got worried the other day, but accidents don't happen that often, right？
Yeah... well, you can't let your guard down, though.
But I feel like something else might happen.
Another thing？
Like you getting seduced by a younger girl, or falling for her instead...
Wait, wait！
But I'll put up with it. If it's just a little fling...
Hey... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
...Hehe, did you take me seriously？
Geez, I'm telling you I won't do that.
